Helene Rask Dalby is a medical doctor and a member of the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (Steering Committee) for the Acute Surgery Database [^src1]. She represents the Danish Society for Clinical Nutrition (Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring) as well as Randers Regional Hospital (Regionshospitalet Randers) in the Central Denmark Region (Region Midtjylland) [^src1]. Her participation in the steering committee underscores the interdisciplinary approach required to address systemic barriers in acute surgery quality measurement, specifically by integrating clinical nutrition perspectives into the database's broader quality improvement efforts [^src1].
